design_philosophy: Utilitarian, rugged, and highly visible. Designed for shop-floor conditions where users wear gloves and work under harsh industrial lighting. Relies on brutalist high-contrast typography, massive touch targets, and unambiguous color coding.

colors.strategy: No subtle grays for interactive elements. Primary action (like 'Scan QR') is intense Signal Blue. Alerts/Errors use stark Safety Red. Warning/Highlight uses Safety Yellow. Borders are thickened to 2px for high contrast.

typography.rules: Never use light weights. Minimum body font weight is 400, but prefer 500 for critical data. Labels must be uppercase with wide tracking for immediate recognition.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: Mobile-First Rugged Design. Optimize for one-handed use and gloved interaction.
spacing_and_layout.touch_targets: Minimum height for interactive elements (buttons, inputs) is 56px (h-14).
spacing_and_layout.grids: Control Room Grid for Desktop Admin: dense data with distinct cell borders (border-collapse style). For mobile equipment lists, use heavy stacked cards with thick bottom borders.
spacing_and_layout.padding: Use generous padding. p-6 or p-8 inside cards to separate dense technical data.

components.buttons: Square or very slightly rounded (rounded-sm). Must have minimum height h-14 on mobile. Active states must shift color significantly. No subtle hover shadows; use hard 2px borders.
components.inputs: Thick 2px borders (border-2 border-input), massive touch areas, clear placeholder text with high contrast.
components.cards: Flat design, 1px or 2px solid border, no soft shadows. Very mechanical and objective.
components.navigation: For mobile shop-floor view, use a fixed bottom navigation bar (Home, Scan, Search) with large icons. For Admin desktop, use a rigid left sidebar.
components.qr_scanner: Full-screen camera takeover on mobile with high-contrast corner reticles. A massive overlay CTA to 'Cancel' or 'Enter Manually'.
components.data_display: Use alternating row colors (Zebra striping) or thick dividers for lists of drawings/manuals to ensure users don't misread rows.
components.tabs: Override standard Shadcn tabs: h-14, massive text, distinct active background (e.g., solid black or blue for active, light gray for inactive).

icons.style: Thick strokes. Set strokeWidth={2.5} or {3} for high visibility.

motion_and_interaction.strategy: Instant and functional. No slow fades. Use immediate visual feedback (color inversions) to confirm touches, critical for gloved users who can't feel screen vibration.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast is met. No text-over-image without solid black scrim.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY. Every button, input, list item, and critical text element must have a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case-role.

login_background.description: Industrial manufacturing plant interior. Use as a darkened background image on the login screen.
login_background.usage: Login screen background (ensure it has a heavy bg-black/60 overlay to keep login form highly legible).

placeholder_equipment.description: Close up of an industrial machine.
placeholder_equipment.usage: Use as a fallback image for equipment records if no specific photo is uploaded.

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply 'Chivo' font to all headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' to all body text. Add the Google Fonts import URL to index.css.
Update tailwind.config.js and index.css to map the strict high-contrast color scheme provided in the 'colors' section.
Override default shadcn component sizes to be 'rugged': Make buttons, inputs, and tabs h-14 or h-16 minimum.
Ensure the QR code scanning page works perfectly on mobile, using a full-screen or prominent camera view component.
For document lists (Drawings, Manuals), use high contrast table rows or large list items separated by thick 2px borders.
Every single interactive element MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
Avoid glassmorphism. Use flat, solid colors with sharp borders for the 'Swiss & High-Contrast' industrial aesthetic.
